title: FE PLAYERS LIST AND MORE
script:
-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Parent UI to CoreGui (so it stays if you reset) or PlayerGui
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "ActivePlayerList"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local success, err = pcall(function()
    ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
end)
if not success then
    ScreenGui.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

-- Dynamic Sound System Setup
local Sounds = {
    Click = { Id = "rbxassetid://9125672610", BaseVolume = 0.5 },
    Hover = { Id = "rbxassetid://9119071592", BaseVolume = 0.2 },
    Success = { Id = "rbxassetid://9125670875", BaseVolume = 0.5 },
    Error = { Id = "rbxassetid://9069609268", BaseVolume = 0.6 },
    Kill = { Id = "rbxassetid://9114223145", BaseVolume = 0.7 }
}

local SoundInstances = {}
local masterVolumeMultiplier = 1.0

for name, data in pairs(Sounds) do
    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
    s.Name = name .. "Sound"
    s.SoundId = data.Id
    s.Volume = data.BaseVolume * masterVolumeMultiplier
    s.Parent = ScreenGui
    SoundInstances[name] = s
end

local function playSound(name)
    if SoundInstances[name] then
        SoundInstances[name]:Play()
    end
end

-- Connects click and hover sound listeners recursively
local function connectUiSounds(guiObject)
    if guiObject:IsA("TextButton") or guiObject:IsA("ImageButton") then
        guiObject.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound("Click")
        end)
        guiObject.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            playSound("Hover")
        end)
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(guiObject:GetChildren()) do
        connectUiSounds(child)
    end
    guiObject.ChildAdded:Connect(connectUiSounds)
end

-- Helper function for the green flash effect
local function handleButtonEffects(button, originalColor)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113) -- Flat Green
    task.delay(0.15, function()
        if button.Name == "EspBtn" and espEnabled then
            button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 110, 45)
        else
            button.BackgroundColor3 = originalColor
        end
    end)
end

    handleButtonEffects(MinimizeBtn, Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60))
    minimized = not minimized
    
    if minimized then
        MainFrame:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 35), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, 0.3, true)
        ScrollFrame.Visible = false
        Menu1Frame.Visible = false
        Menu2Frame.Visible = false
        Menu3Frame.Visible = false
    else
        MainFrame:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 320), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, 0.3, true)
        task.delay(0.15, function() ScrollFrame.Visible = true end)
    end
end)

-- Sub-Menu Toggle Functionality

    handleButtonEffects(ToggleBtn1, Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60))
    if not minimized then
        Menu1Frame.Visible = not Menu1Frame.Visible
    end

    handleButtonEffects(ToggleBtn2, Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60))
    if not minimized then
        Menu2Frame.Visible = not Menu2Frame.Visible
    end
end)

    handleButtonEffects(ToggleBtn3, Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60))
    if not minimized then
        Menu3Frame.Visible = not Menu3Frame.Visible
    end
end)

-- Adaptive Sound Volume Logic
SetVolBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    handleButtonEffects(SetVolBtn, Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100))
    local rawInput = tonumber(VolumeBox.Text)
    if rawInput then
        masterVolumeMultiplier = math.clamp(rawInput, 0.1, 10)
        -- Adaptively scale each audio instance proportionately
        for name, data in pairs(Sounds) do
            if SoundInstances[name] then
                SoundInstances[name].Volume = data.BaseVolume * masterVolumeMultiplier
            end
        end
        VolumeBox.Text = tostring(masterVolumeMultiplier)
        playSound("Success")
    else
        VolumeBox.Text = tostring(masterVolumeMultiplier)
        playSound("Error")
    end
end)

-- ESP Functionality
local espEnabled = false
local espObjects = {}

local function clearESP()
    for _, obj in ipairs(espObjects) do
        if obj then obj:Destroy() end
    end
    espObjects = {}
end

local function applyESP(player)
    if player == Players.LocalPlayer then return end
    
    local function highlightCharacter(char)
        if not char then return end
        local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
        if not hrp then return end

        local box = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
        box.Size = char:GetExtentsSize()
        box.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        box.AlwaysOnTop = true
        box.ZIndex = 5
        box.Adornee = char
        box.Transparency = 0.6
        box.Parent = char
        table.insert(espObjects, box)

        local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboard.Adornee = hrp
        billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        
        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        label.Text = player.DisplayName
        label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
        label.TextSize = 14
        label.Parent = billboard
        
        billboard.Parent = char
        table.insert(espObjects, billboard)
    end

    if player.Character then
        highlightCharacter(player.Character)
    end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(highlightCharacter)
end

EspBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    espEnabled = not espEnabled
    handleButtonEffects(EspBtn, Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55))
    
    if espEnabled then
        EspBtn.Text = "ESP Enabled"
        playSound("Success")
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            applyESP(player)
        end
    else
        EspBtn.Text = "ESP All Players"
        clearESP()
    end
end)

-- Self Kill Functionality
KillBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    handleButtonEffects(KillBtn, Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40))
    local char = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if char then
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            playSound("Kill")
            humanoid.Health = 0
        end
    end
end)

-- Teleport Logic & Error Alert Handling
local function getPlayerByName(name)
    name = name:lower()
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p.Name:lower():sub(1, #name) == name or p.DisplayName:lower():sub(1, #name) == name then
            return p
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local isDisplayingError = false
local function displayTpError()
    playSound("Error")
    if isDisplayingError then return end
    isDisplayingError = true
    TpErrorLabel.Visible = true
    
    task.delay(3, function()
        TpErrorLabel.Visible = false
        isDisplayingError = false
    end)
end

TpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    handleButtonEffects(TpBtn, Color3.fromRGB(45, 110, 45))
    local targetText = TargetBox.Text
    if targetText ~= "" then
        local targetPlayer = getPlayerByName(targetText)
        if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character then
            local targetHRP = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local localHRP = Players.LocalPlayer.Character and Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            
            if targetHRP and localHRP then
                localHRP.CFrame = targetHRP.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
                playSound("Success")
            else
                displayTpError()
            end
        else
            displayTpError()
        end
    else
        displayTpError()
    end
end)

local UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
UIListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
UIListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
UIListLayout.Parent = ScrollFrame

UIListLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
    ScrollFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
end)

-- Smooth Custom Dragging System
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

local function updateDrag(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
        startPos.X.Scale, 
        startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 
        startPos.Y.Scale, 
        startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
end

TitleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

TitleBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        updateDrag(input)
    end
end)

-- Player Card Styling and List Handling
local function createPlayerLabel(player)
    if ScrollFrame:FindFirstChild(player.Name) then return end

    local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Label.Name = player.Name
    Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 28)
    Label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
    Label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansSemibold
    Label.TextSize = 14
    Label.Text = "  " .. player.DisplayName .. " (@" .. player.Name .. ")"
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Label.Parent = ScrollFrame

    local LabelCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    LabelCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    LabelCorner.Parent = Label
    
    if espEnabled then
        applyESP(player)
    end
end

local function removePlayerLabel(player)
    local Label = ScrollFrame:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
    if Label then
        Label:Destroy()
    end
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    createPlayerLabel(player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(createPlayerLabel)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(removePlayerLabel)

-- Connect UI event listeners for automated sound effects
connectUiSounds(ScreenGui)
